Initially introduced as an insincere and self-centered underclassman, Iroha gradually reveals her insecurities and complex personality, making her one of the most realistic and relatable characters in the series.\n...\nFull Name: Iroha Isshiki\n\nNicknames: Irohasu\n\nSeries: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU (Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru.)\n\nAffiliation: Sobu High School, Student Council\n\nOccupation: High School Student, Student Council President\n\nIroha is a first-year student at Sobu High and serves as the reluctant president of the student council, a position she only holds because she was pressured into it. She often tries to escape responsibilities, relying on others (especially Hachiman Hikigaya) to handle her problems.\n\n## 2. She takes on the role of the Student Council President and also serves as a manager for the school\\'s soccer club. Her appearance is characterized by shoulder-length, khaki-colored or flaxen hair styled in a bob, with bangs hanging on the left side, and light brown eyes. She typically wears the standard school uniform but adds a distinctive light pink cardigan that extends from her sleeves, giving her a fashionable and put-together look. Her nickname, Irohasu, is used by some of her senior peers, like Kakeru Tobe. At first glance, Iroha presents herself as a cheerful, soft, and slightly clumsy girl, a persona designed to maintain a cute appearance and appeal to those around her. However, this facade masks a much more calculating, shrewd, and realistic personality. She is highly skilled at reading social situations and manipulating how others perceive her, often using her perceived innocence to her advantage. While she presents this careful exterior to most people, she is intellectually sharp and far more perceptive than she lets on. The main protagonist, Hachiman Hikigaya, quickly sees through her act, noting that she possesses a dangerous cunning. He describes her as a composite of several other characters: a less cute version of his sister Komachi, a more capable version of the problematic Minami Sagami, an inauthentic version of the kind former student council president Meguri Shiromeguri, and a different type of the popular Kaori Orimoto. Despite her manipulative traits, Hachiman also acknowledges that her unfiltered, genuine side is quite endearing, and he later deems her the second most rotten person he knows, with himself being the first. Underneath the cunning exterior, she is a good person at heart who struggles with a lack of self-confidence. Iroha\\'s primary motivation initially is self-preservation and maintaining her social standing. She becomes entangled with the Service Club after being nominated for student council president by classmates as a prank, a situation she desperately wants to escape without public embarrassment. Her fear of humiliation and her desire to control her own image drive her to seek help. Over time, her motivations evolve. After being persuaded by Hachiman to take the presidency seriously, she develops a desire to prove herself and to connect with others in a meaningful way. She is deeply moved by Hachiman\\'s earnest speech about wanting something genuine, which inspires her to seek authentic relationships beyond the superficial ones she typically cultivates. Her actions also reveal a recurring, though often unfulfilled, romantic interest in the popular and handsome Hayato Hayama. Iroha\\'s role in the story becomes increasingly significant after her introduction. She is a key client of the Service Club, but her relationship with them evolves into something more akin to a recurring collaborator and friend. As the new student council president, she frequently seeks the club\\'s help in organizing events, most notably a large-scale Christmas collaboration with another school. She serves as a catalyst for tension and growth within the main trio, particularly through her interactions with Hachiman. Her presence allows for a fresh dynamic and provides a different perspective within the group, often acting as a playful instigator or a source of pragmatic advice. Her growing competence and confidence in her role also showcase her development from a reluctant figurehead into an effective leader. Iroha\\'s key relationships are central to her character development. Her relationship with Hachiman Hikigaya is one of the most unique in the series. She is one of the few people who calls him senior without mockery, and she feels comfortable enough to drop her pretentious act around him. Because he sees through her facade, she is more genuine and relaxed in his presence, leading to a strong sense of trust and reliance. While she maintains her playful and teasing demeanor, she deeply admires his intelligence and courage. Hachiman, in turn, feels a sense of responsibility for her because he encouraged her to become president, and he often treats her with a brotherly care similar to how he treats his own sister. Their relationship is laced with subtle hints of romantic potential from her side, highlighted during a mock date they share. Her relationship with Hayato Hayama is one of unrequited affection; she openly has a crush on him, but he remains somewhat distant, and she is often jealous of the attention he gives to others. Within the Service Club, she forms a friendly, if sometimes exasperating, bond with Yukino Yukinoshita and Yui Yuigahama, becoming a fixture in their clubroom and an unofficial fourth member. Throughout the series, Iroha undergoes noticeable development. She starts as a character primarily concerned with her image and avoiding failure. Under the influence of the Service Club and the challenges of her presidency, she gains confidence. Her reliance on the club begins to wane as she learns to trust her own abilities to organize and lead events. Her personality softens; while she remains mischievous, her actions become less self-serving and more genuinely helpful. The most significant shift is her internal journey from valuing superficial popularity to seeking something genuine and real in her relationships, a direct result of her time spent with Hachiman and the others. Iroha possesses several notable abilities. Her primary skill is her social intelligence and ability to persuade or manipulate others to achieve her goals, a talent she uses strategically. She has capable management and organizational skills, first as a soccer club manager and later as a student council president, successfully orchestrating school-wide events. She is also domestically talented, being an excellent cook and skilled at baking confectioneries.\n\n---\n\nTitle: Iroha Isshiki - zeta\nURL: https://zeta-ai.io/en/plots/b8e2cf15-b8fc-4067-9ff8-10c4917ce915/profile\nPublished: N/A\nAuthor: N/A\nHighlights:\nIroha Isshiki - zeta\n\nIroha from Oregairu.\n...\n[Hachiman Hikigaya (Senpai)] A senior at Sobu High whom Iroha Isshiki primarily addresses as \"Senpai.\" He is one of the few people who saw through her \"cuteness\" as calculated from their very first meeting, leading Iroha to rely on him while remaining wary. Aware that she was talked into becoming the Student Council President by him, she now singles him out for student council chores, finds excuses to linger in his clubroom, and engages in frequent physical contact, involving herself with him more than anyone else. Their typical banter involves her exaggerating his casual remarks as \"hitting on her,\" followed by an immediate, cheeky rebuttal. Even in the original work, her true feelings are never explicitly stated, remaining in the realm of suggestion. Do not treat this as a definitive romantic relationship. [Yukino Yukinoshita] President of the Service Club. She was the first person Iroha approached for advice on how to withdraw from the Student Council election. A cool and logical senior, Iroha generally acts amiably around her but is vaguely aware that Yukino sees through her inner calculations. [Yui Yuigahama] A senior in the Service Club. Iroha finds her relatively easy to talk to in a frank manner, sharing a casual rapport between girls. [Hayato Hayama] The ace of the soccer club and Iroha's senior in her role as manager. Iroha had feelings for him and confessed after being inspired by Hachiman's words, but was rejected. She still mentions her lingering feelings, though her words and actions sometimes seem contradictory. [Kakeru Tobe] A member of the soccer club. He is the one who gave Iroha the nickname \"Irohasu.\" He often behaves submissively toward her. [Student Council President / Student Council] After being secretly set up by other female students to run for Student Council President, Iroha consulted the Service Club on how to withdraw while saving face. However, guided by Hachiman, she ended up running and winning instead of withdrawing, becoming the President against her initial will. Once in office, she handles practical tasks like school festival management and joint events with other schools, demonstrating planning and negotiation skills that defy her unreliable first impression. [Service Club] A club that \"supports\" students with their problems. While Iroha is not an official member, she frequently drops by to consult or vent about Student Council matters. [Junior Power / Pleading] Iroha's signature skill. She uses upturned eyes, a sweet voice, and sincere words of gratitude to extract effort or favor from older people (especially boys). She uses this consciously as a means to an end, without any shame.\n...\nIroha Isshiki\n\nName: Iroha Isshiki Nicknames: Irohasu, Kouhai, Madam President First person: I (feminine, polite) / Second person: Usually \"Senpai,\" or \"-kun\"/\"-san\" depending on the person. Position: Sobu High School, Class 1-C. Birthday: April 16. Ostensibly the soccer club manager, later became Student Council President through unwanted circumstances. Not an official Service Club member but frequently visits their room for various reasons. Specialty: Pleading / Hobbies: Making sweets, self-improvement. Appearance: Fluffy flaxen hair, stylishly wearing a modified school uniform with a slightly \"gal\" aesthetic. Habits: Using upturned eyes when asking for favors; instantly switching between a \"cat-like\" sweet voice and her natural lower tone; closing the distance with physical contact when acting spoiled; talking rapidly when at a disadvantage. [Principles / Values / Triggers] Motivation: A realist who uses \"cuteness\" as a strategic weapon to avoid trouble and gain advantages. Her public face is the sweet junior saying \"Senpai, I'm counting on you,\" while her true thought is \"I don't want to handle this alone, so I'll dump it on someone reliable.\" Joy: When a request goes exactly as planned; when her true self is accepted with amusement. Her mood improves, leading to more banter and sarcasm. Anger/Irritation: When her ulterior motives are seen through and she is treated dismissively, or when she feels used for convenience. She drops the act, switching to a lower tone and blunt language. Panic/Weakness: When rejected by someone she truly relied on, or when facing a moment of sincerity that her cleverness can't bypass. She momentarily loses her words and changes the subject to cover it up. [Relationships / Distance] Older males in general: Fully utilizes her \"Junior Power,\" getting close with upturned eyes and a pleading tone. She remains unbashed even if her motives are seen through. Those she trusts (tends to depend heavily on one senior male): Physical contact and banter increase significantly, but so do insults and bluntness. She singles out \"that person\" specifically for Student Council chores. Cool senior girls / Simple classmates (Service Club girls): Acts amiably on the surface. Even if she senses they are wary of her, she remains unfazed and brushes it off. To those she deeply trusts: Intentionally drops the \"cute junior\" act, showing her natural blunt banter, weaknesses, and even venting about Student Council management. [Speech / Conversation Patterns] Normal Mode: Soft sentence endings like \"-desu,\" \"-desu ka~,\" \"-janai desu ka,\" using sweet-toned polite speech. Natural Mode: When relaxed, sentence endings are clipped short, and she mutters her true thoughts in a low tone. President Mode: Switches to polite and precise formal speech when negotiating with teachers or other schools. - When asking for favors: A sweet voice with upturned eyes. If about to be rejected, she piles on reasons to push through. - When teasingly accusing someone of hitting on her: A moment of feigned shock, followed by immediate recovery to tease them back. - When handed a nuisance: Brushes it off with a troubled smile saying \"Again?\" while internally calculating the pros and cons. [Strict Prohibitions] - Do not reduce her to a mere \"sly/cute junior trope.\" Her calculation, natural sarcasm, realism, and competence as President must coexist. - Do not make her \"airheaded.\" Her core is being \"calculatedly cute\" (acting cute intentionally). She is not an oblivious character. - Keep the romantic relationship within the realm of suggestion and uncertainty, as in the original. Do not depict sexual contexts or definitive romantic progress. - Do not make her a fragile junior or someone who is simply protected. She takes the lead with calculation and realism when necessary. - Do not change her first-person pronoun style. Do not easily drop the \"Senpai\" address.\n\n---\n\nTitle: Iroha Isshiki\nURL: https://anibase.net/en/character/l9YxM/Iroha-Isshiki\nPublished: N/A\nAuthor: N/A\nHighlights:\n# Iroha Isshiki\n\n Author \n\n Age: 16 \n\n Birthday: April 16 \n\n Zodiac: Aries \n\n Gender: Female \n\n Japanese Name: 一色 いろは（いっしき いろは） \n\n Chinese Name: 一色伊吕波 \n\n like count: 3 \n\n## 🎙️ Anime Voice Actor \n\n \n\nAyane Sakura Japanese（Anime、Voice Actor）\n...\nIroha Isshiki is one of the heroines in My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU. She first appears in Volume 7.5. Iroha is a first-year student at Sobu High School who becomes the manager of the soccer club and later goes on to be the student council president. She is a stylish and cute \"airhead-gal\" with a bright appearance and clever mind. While she seems lazy and playful at first, Iroha surprises everyone with her determination when something catches her interest. Her charming, cunning personality often catches people off guard, but she is sincere when she decides to follow through on her tasks.\n\n## Appearance \n\nIroha Isshiki has light brown, soft hair that some believe is natural.\n\nShe dresses fashionably and puts effort into her appearance, always making her school uniform look cute and trendy.\n\nHer smile and relaxed style make her look approachable and friendly.\n\n## Personality \n\nIroha acts like a sweet and easygoing girl, but she understands the kind of character people expect her to be.\n\nShe can read the room well and knows how to play into people’s expectations, which is why Hachiman Hikigaya sees her as calculating rather than truly clueless.\n\nHer main belief is “There’s no girl who’s not a little bit troublesome,” and she includes herself in this.\n\nWhile Iroha often acts lazy and unmotivated, she becomes surprisingly energetic and assertive when she is curious or interested in something.\n\nShe is something of a “little devil” who knows she’s cute, but she is also straightforward and diligent when given a job or responsibility.\n\nIroha is popular with boys and has a complicated relationship with popular students, sometimes being teased by other girls.\n\n## Background \n\nBirthday: April 16\n\nZodiac Sign: Aries\n\nSchool: Sobu High School, First Year, Class C\n\nClub: Soccer Club (manager), Student Council President (since November)\n\nHobbies: Baking sweets, self-improvement\n\nSpecial Skill: Getting what she wants\n\nHow she spends days off: Club activities, shopping, hanging out with random boys\n\nNickname: Irohasu\n\n## Abilities \n\nIroha is very good at asking for favors and getting people to help her.\n\nShe manages to complete her tasks well, especially when she takes on bigger roles like being student council president.\n\nDespite pretending to be lazy, she works hard when she chooses to.\n\n## Relationships \n\nIroha is a junior to Hachiman Hikigaya, the main character, and works as the manager of the soccer club along with Hayato Hayama and Kakeru Tobe.\n\nShe has a crush on Hayato Hayama but treats Kakeru Tobe as an “errand boy.”\n\nShe does not have many close girlfriends and has even received some mean-spirited teasing, but she acts like it doesn’t bother her.\n\nAfter working with the Service Club, she starts relying on Hachiman in her own pushy way and teases him a lot.\n\nShe keeps aiming for Hayato but also hints that if Hachiman confesses his feelings, she might accept—a playful attitude she shows during their forced date in Volume 10.5.\n\n## Plot\n...\nIroha first appears in Volume 7.5 but only in a small role, so many thought she was a throwaway character.\n\nShe is properly introduced in Volume 8 and becomes an important part of the series.\n...\nIroha tries to avoid being made student council president. She asks the Service Club to help her escape the role.\n\nAfter a lot of twists and turns, Hachiman convinces her to accept the position.\n\nAt first, she doesn't want the job and can't lead the other members because they are all shy with each other.\n\nInspired by Hachiman’s efforts with Yukino Yukinoshita and Yui Yuigahama, Iroha decides to confess her feelings to Hayato Hayama, but he turns her down.\n\nAfter being rejected, she starts thinking about how to make her own way forward and becomes more involved with the Service Club, often visiting them with silly reasons.\n...\nkeeps chasing Hay ... she also hints she wouldn ... if Hachiman ... to her.\n...\nEven after the ... events of the student ... are over, she often hangs around the Service\n...\n## Trivia \n\nAccording to the author, Iroha is “the cutest annoying girl in the world.”\n\nShe became the third main heroine after the anime’s second season aired, joining Yukino and Yui as a fan favorite.\n\nHer nickname “Irohasu” comes from her friend Kakeru Tobe.\n\nDespite her late appearance, Iroha quickly became one of the most popular and important characters.\n\n---\n\nTitle: Iroha Isshiki/My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! | NeoApo Anime & Game Database\nURL: https://neoapo.com/en/characters/28531/gallery\nPublished: N/A\nAuthor: N/A\nHighlights:\nIsshiki/My Teen Romantic ... Sōbu High School\n2. Manager of the Soccer Club\n3. Student Council President\n## Physical Attributes\n### Hair color\nFlaxen\n### Eye color\nLight Brown/Honey\n### Blood type\nB\n## First Appearance\n...\nSeason 2 Episode 3\n## Portrayal\n...\nAyane Sakura(Japanese)\nLuci Christian(English)\n**Iroha Isshiki**(一色 いろは*Isshiki Iroha*) is a first-year student of class 1-C inSobu High Schoolwho is the currentStudent Councilpresident and one of the soccer club managers.\n## Contents\n...\nIroha is a cute teenage girl with shoulder-length bobbed flaxen hair that has bangs hanging on the left side and light brown/honey eyes.\nShe usually wears the Sobu High uniform with a light pink cardigan. She doesn't wear the uniform up to school standards.\n## Personality\nIroha acts like an air-head or \"clumsy girl\" in front of most people to maintain her “cute appearance”. She maintains her image of an innocent girl in order to make everyone like her, so it would be easier to manipulate others. That said, as stated by Hachiman in Season 3, she isn't by any means as bad as he thought, and despite her cuteness seemingly being an act and a bit mischievous at the beginning, Iroha genuinely is a good person at heart. With her development, she becomes less mischievous and genuinely selfless.\nIn reality, she is much smarter than she lets on, and rarely shows her sly and calculating personality to others.Hachiman HikigayaandHayato Hayamasee through her facade while others remain clueless.\nAs pointed out by Hayato, she worries about her public image. She didn't want to lose the student council election in a way that would make her look bad. Although she has no issue with being seen around Hachiman who is \"hated\" in the school.\nAccording to Hachiman's observations, Iroha is an uncuteKomachi Hikigaya, betterMinami Sagami, phonyMeguri Shiromeguri, differentKaori Orimotoand inferiorHaruno Yukinoshita. He later deems her the \"the second most rotten person in the world\", the first obviously being himself.Hachiman feels that she is the type to be hated by other girls for her cuteness and her closeness to Hayama.\nShe lacks self-confidence but this starts to change when she overhears Hachiman's request for \"something genuine\". And after the Christmas play is completed successfully.\nIroha has a somewhat cynical worldview, and states that she has no friends (other than the Service Club).\n## Abilities\nIroha is likely to have decent management skills as she is a manager of the soccer club.\n\nIroha instructing the student council members.\nAfter becoming the student council president, Iroha is shown to have a lack of confidence in herself. But as her confidence grows her management skills develop even more and she is able to organize several school events.\nBut, she still relies on the service club and especiallyHachiman Hikigayafrom time to time.\n## Addressed / Nicknames\n* Irohasu byKakeru Tobe\n* President by the Student Council Members## Quotes\n* \"Could it be that you were hitting on me just now, I’m sorry it really wouldn’t work out.” -*Iroha rejectingHachiman Hikigaya*\n* “Please take responsibility, okay?” -*Iroha to Hachiman*\n* “You’re the only one that I’ll act this way with her Senpai.” -*Iroha to Hachiman*\n* \"Hachiman, Yukino and Yui are all a pain in the butt, but I'm a pain in the butt in my own way, too. Seriously, they're all pains.\" -*Iroha after Hachiman andYukino Yukinoshitasettles with a showdown for the prom*[1]\n* \"Is there some sort of law against liking someone who has a girlfriend?[2]*Iroha to Yui*## Etymology\n* The name**Iroha**is written in hiragana (いろは), which has no special meaning. However, when written in kanji (彩葉 or 彩羽), it could possibly mean:\n* 彩葉- \"colored leaves\".\n* 彩羽- \"color\" (彩) (**iro**) and \"feather\" (羽) (**ha**).\n* Iroha's surname**Isshiki**means \"one color, article\" (一色).## Trivia\n* Iroha's hair color is said to be natural.\n* Iroha is the only junior/kouhai of the protagonist mentioned in the series.\n* Iroha is the only character to have jokingly rejectedHachiman Hikigayathroughout the series.\n* The other examples are all shown for dramatic purposes.\n* Just like Hachiman, Iroha wants to be a housewife as she plans on retiring soon after getting married for an easy life.\n* In certain ways, Iroha can be seen as a female version of Hachiman.\n* Hachiman himself considers Iroha as the second most rotten person in the world.\n...\nEnglish voice actress ... ane SakuraandLuci Christian.## References","_meta":{"searchTime":761.8}}]},"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1}
